source.description: AI-authored Kotlin/Wasm harness compiled against the human-authored kotlinx.serialization-cbor 1.11.0 library (kotlinx.serialization, Apache-2.0) to expose deterministic corpus tests for real upstream library behavior.

toolchain.name: Kotlin/Wasm + Binaryen
toolchain.version: Kotlin Gradle plugin 2.3.21; kotlinx.serialization-cbor 1.11.0; wasm-opt version 125

notes: The fixture uses a thin AI-authored export harness to drive real kotlinx.serialization CBOR binary encoder/decoder code paths. Assertions combine decoded values and encoded byte sizes to exercise real serialization behavior without requiring binary memory assertions.
